acceptance: make pr-open or oracle planning detects a base sha that is not the merge base with origin/develop and either refreshes it or fails with a clear message
context: Workaround used: gh pr close then gh pr reopen. Not a root-caused GitHub behaviour; the cause of the stale base is unverified.
description: PR #3109 was pushed after its branch had been merged with a newer develop. GitHub kept comparing it against an old base (base sha 27f7a7d1f, changed_files 481, additions 14532, 46 commits) while the real change was 11 files. gh pr diff failed with HTTP 406 (over 300 files) and the oracle planned a very-high tier ('2247 code lines across 13 areas', soundness paths touched), where the first reviewer errored. Closing and reopening the PR refreshed the base (0f5ed3aa7, 11 files, 4 commits) and the oracle then reported 'no soundness path changed'. Neither make pr-open nor the oracle detects the mismatch between the PR's recorded base and origin/develop.
